verdict.rationale: The evidence shows event-triggered rules whose steps can wait and act on a conversation after delays (e.g., at 24, 48 and 72 hours), plus one-off snoozing. Neither is a recurring schedule (cron-like or periodic jobs). Delayed per-conversation rule steps are an adjacent feature, not the ability to schedule recurring jobs or workflows, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
